summary: CycloneX is tracking a Category 2 cyclone that is still strengthening over the Arabian Sea.
Landfall is likely near Mumbai in about 48 hours, as a Category 3 cyclone.
The Konkan and south Gujarat coasts need to prepare now.

qa.Why is it strengthening?: Sea water under the storm is about 29 °C and wind shear is low. The eye has cleared and its cloud tops cooled 24 °C in 18 hours, so the storm is getting stronger.
qa.Where will it land?: Most model members cross the coast within 40 km of Mumbai, between Alibag and Palghar. Confidence is 72% at landfall, so the point can still shift north or south.
qa.Who should evacuate?: People within 5 km of the coast in Mumbai, Thane and Raigad, and the fishing villages at Alibag, Uran and Palghar. Move to shelters before the winds pass 90 km/h.
